verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Billing as API-drivable across its core objects: the Subscriptions API, Trial Offer API, Billing Meters API with an API reference page for meter events, and webhooks for status transitions. An official MCP server lets agents call the Stripe API, and an official CLI is also documented. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (every probed path returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Billing through the API.
